item.title: Tour & Spray Masterclass with Faena Rose at Museum of Graffiti
item.description: Miami, FL - January 10, 2026 - Guests took part in a curator-led visit to the Museum of Graffiti, exploring the evolution of graffiti from its 1970s New York roots to its rise as contemporary fine art. The experience concluded with a hands-on outdoor spray-painting workshop led by a museum artist-educator, where attendees learned core techniques and created their own graffiti-inspired works.
